info.description: REST API for the NDHU campus second-hand textbook marketplace.
info.title: NDHU Second-Hand Book Store API

post.description: Classifies the condition of a book image using the AI microservice. Accepts the ID of an already-uploaded image.
Authenticates a user with email and password, returns a JWT token
Invalidates the current JWT and clears the session cookie
Creates a new user account and sends an email verification link
Sends a new verification email to the specified address if the account is unverified

get.description: Validates the CAS ticket and issues a JWT
Redirects the browser to the NDHU CAS login page
Verifies a user's email address using the token from the verification email
Returns the authenticated user's cart items

post.description: Adds a listing to the authenticated user's cart

delete.description: Removes a cart item from the authenticated user's cart

post.description: Registers an image metadata record in the database after upload to S3
Accepts a multipart file upload, stores it in S3, registers it in the database, and returns the image ID and CDN URL.

parameters.description: Image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP; max 5 MB)
parameters.name: file

get.description: Paginated, filterable list of book listings. Returns the full page in the JSON body and total count in X-Total-Count header.

parameters.description: Full-text search on title, author, or ISBN
parameters.name: search

post.description: Publishes a new book listing for the authenticated seller.

get.description: Returns all listings created by the authenticated user, newest first.
Returns a single listing with seller info and image URLs.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a listing by setting its status to 'delisted'. Only the seller or an admin may delete.

patch.description: Partially updates a listing. Only the seller may update their own listing.

get.description: Returns the conversation between the authenticated user and the other party for a given listing. Marks received messages as read.

post.description: Sends a message from the authenticated user. If the sender is the seller, they must provide the receiver_id (the buyer). If the sender is a buyer, the message is sent to the seller.
post.summary: Send a message about a listing

get.description: Returns one summary entry per unique (listing, other_user) conversation pair the authenticated user is part of.
Returns the number of unread messages for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Marks a single message as read. Only the receiver may mark a message as read.

get.description: Returns all notifications for the authenticated user, newest first.

patch.description: Marks every unread notification for the authenticated user as read.

get.description: Returns the number of unread notifications for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Marks a single notification as read. Returns 404 if the notification does not belong to the current user.

get.description: Returns all orders for the authenticated user, newest first

post.description: Creates an order from the authenticated user's cart, marks listings as sold, and clears the cart

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's name and/or avatar image

image_id.description: ImageID is the UUID of an already-uploaded image to classify.
